source.label: De-identified saved home observations
notes: Read-only SQLite snapshot of previously saved completed checks; no new probes were run.
Only per-layer aggregates are published; endpoint addresses, SSID, MAC and raw errors are excluded.
Incident policy replays historical observations; local transition records are not historical messages that were actually sent.
Historical replay is evaluated at the fixed cutoff/last observation; generatedAt is the actual export time.

policy.durationSemantics: Span from first abnormal check through last observed check or confirmed recovery; excludes collection gaps and unknown intervals. This is observed monitoring span, not proven continuous outage time.
policy.latencyAggregation: p50Ms is the mean of available per-target p50 values; p95Ms is the maximum per-target p95, not a pooled percentile.
policy.notificationSemantics: Durable local transition records only; no external messages are sent.
